forms: <$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>Poor <$cdef(27)>Meowth</color>, having their shack flooded like that...

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>You know, if you block the source of the water like you did
for the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center, <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,8)>the water might drain away!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Mud can be quite stubborn. Sometimes just spraying it with
water isn’t enough to wash it away.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>It would be best to soften it first with some <$cdef(27)>bubbles</color>.

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Pokémon who specialize in <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(8)>ing can probably spit
some <$cdef(27)>bubbles for you.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>You’ll need <$cdef(27)><$ifull(819)> to make that. I often
see those in caves or other dim places.
<$voicel(1,6)>It’s likely there are some around this town too.

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Once you’ve made a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1367)>, go ahead and
put it by <$cdef(27)>Meowth’s shack.
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,4)>This town is so dark, even during the day.

<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>If you manage to light the place up more, <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,8)>I think it might
lift the spirits of the Pokémon around here.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>There are lots of different light sources you could use, but
I believe <$voicel(1,8)>electricity might be the most effective!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>I think you should make some homes Pokémon would
like to live in.

<$voicel(1,5)>If you do, I’d say it’s likely more Pokémon will return, like
they did in the last town.
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>And I’d wager they’ll help you out too!
